title: Mutational Analysis of Ocriplasmin to Reduce Proteolytic and Autolytic Activity
author: Baghban, Farajnia, et al.

steps.title: Generate 3D models
steps.instruction: Obtain three‑dimensional structures of wild‑type ocriplasmin and the three designed mutants (A59T, K156E, and the combined A59T/K156E) using the Swiss‑Model and I‑TASSER web servers.

steps.title: Introduce mutations and visualize
steps.instruction: Load the wild‑type model into SPDBV, introduce the A59T and K156E point mutations, and save the mutant structures; then open each structure in PyMOL for visual inspection and confirmation of the mutation sites.

steps.title: Perform protein interaction analysis
steps.instruction: Upload each wild‑type and mutant structure to the Protein Interaction Calculator (PIC) server (crick.mbu.iisc.ernet.in/PIC) and run the default analysis to obtain interaction profiles.

steps.title: Dock substrate S‑2403
steps.instruction: Prepare the chromogenic substrate S‑2403 (L‑pyroglutamyl‑L‑phenylalanyl‑L‑lysine‑p‑nitroaniline hydrochloride, Chromogenix, Milano, Italy, catalog 822,254‑39) and perform molecular docking of this substrate to each ocriplasmin variant using AutoDock 4.2.6 together with AutoDock Tools 1.5.6; record the calculated free binding energies (wild‑type = ‑7.67 kcal/mol, autolytic‑type = ‑6.93 kcal/mol, proteolytic‑type = ‑6.75 kcal/mol, mixed‑type = ‑5.84 kcal/mol).

steps.title: Run 100‑ns MD simulations
steps.instruction: For each protein‑substrate complex, set up a 100‑nanosecond molecular dynamics simulation using GROMACS 2016; after the run, compute backbone RMSD, RMSF of active‑site residues His61, Asp104, and Ser199, and the center‑of‑mass distance between ocriplasmin and the substrate.

substeps.instruction: Calculate average RMSD values: wild‑type = 0.28 nm; proteolytic mutant = 0.33 nm; autolytic mutant = 0.34 nm; mixed mutant = 0.39 nm.
Extract RMSF profiles for residues His61, Asp104, Ser199 and compare mutant versus wild‑type fluctuations.
Determine average center‑of‑mass distances to assess proximity of substrate to each variant.

steps.title: Analyze and compare results
steps.instruction: Compile the docking free‑energy values, RMSD, RMSF, and center‑of‑mass distance data to evaluate how each mutation affects proteolytic and autolytic activity of ocriplasmin.
